You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority in your place of residence, to place an order. By ordering, you confirm that the information you provide is accurate and that you are legally able to enter into this agreement.

Any statements about the products describe the look, feel and appearance of skin and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. Individual results vary. Always read the label, patch test before first use, and discontinue use if irritation occurs. Any third-party brand names or trademarks referenced are the property of their respective owners and do not imply endorsement.

Prices are shown on the Site and may change at any time before you order. Prices are exclusive of taxes and shipping unless stated; applicable taxes and shipping are calculated at checkout. You authorise us and our payment processor to charge your chosen payment method for the total amount of your order. If a product is listed at an incorrect price due to an error, we may cancel the order and refund any amount paid.

Discount codes and promotions are subject to their own terms, cannot be combined unless we say so, have no cash value, and may be changed or withdrawn at any time. Bundle and buy-more-save-more pricing applies only while the offer is live.
